Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and others 
Counsel for Revisionist :- M. Gautam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 27.07.1992 passed by 6th Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aligarh in Case No. 147 of 1992 convicting the revisionist under Section 3/7 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing him to undergo six months simple imprisonment and fine of Rs. 500/-.

Thereagainst accused-revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No 64 of 1992 which has been allowed partly by Special Judge (Essential Commodities), Aligarh vide judgment and order dated 13.09.1993 by confirming the conviction and fine but setting aside the punishment of imprisonment.
This revision has been filed challenging both the aforesaid orders.
